channel.title: The Grant Desk - Visual & Media Arts, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Visual & Media Arts, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily. Each drop carries at most 10 grants, closest deadlines first; the rest follow the next Sunday.

item.title: 21 new Visual & Media Arts grants - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
• True Blue Fellowship 2027
    https://bowseat.org/programs/true-blue-fellowship/
    Bow Seat Ocean Awareness Programs · deadline Closed 30 Aug 2026 · Up to USD 2,500 in project funding per fellow, plus mentorship and capacity-building programming. Twelve youth are selected annually. No application fee.
  • Archipel Butor Livre de dialogue Creation Residency 2027
    https://www.archipel-butor.fr/residence-creation/
    Archipel Butor · deadline Closed 30 Aug 2026 · Creation grant of EUR 2,000 gross per month per artist, so roughly EUR 4,000 each across the two months and EUR 8,000 for the pair. Up to two return journeys per person are covered within France and Europe. Accommodation is provided in Michel Butor's writer's house. No application fee.
  • University of Johannesburg Artists in Residence 2027
    https://arts.uj.ac.za/artists-in-residence/
    UJ Arts & Culture, University of Johannesburg · deadline Closed 31 Aug 2026 · Stipend of ZAR 12,000 per month across a 10-month residency, so roughly ZAR 120,000 in total. No travel or accommodation budget on top of the stipend, and studio or rehearsal space is limited rather than guaranteed. No application fee.
  • The Kitchen / Central Location Open Call (foodculture days Biennale, Vevey 2027)
    https://opencall.foodculturedays.com/en
    foodculture days · deadline Closed 31 Aug 2026 · CHF 15,000 all-inclusive project budget (VAT included), covering travel, visas, equipment and additional kitchen equipment rental, per diems, materials and artist fees. Food costs and accommodation in Vevey are covered separately by foodculture days. Three shortlisted collectives each receive a CHF 250 research fee to develop their proposal in Phase 2. One collective is selected. No application fee.
  • The Impart & Nalli Fellowships 2027-28
    https://imp-art.org/fellowship-grant/impart-x-nalli-fellowships/
    Impart in collaboration with Nalli Silks · deadline Closed 31 Aug 2026 · Up to INR 5.5 lakhs (INR 550,000) per fellow towards project execution, covering research-related expenses including travel, fieldwork and documentation subject to approval. Two fellowships are awarded. No application fee.
  • Dorothy Antoinette LaSelle Travel Fellowship 2026
    https://www.lasellefoundation.org/travel-fellowship
    Dorothy Antoinette LaSelle Foundation · deadline Closed 31 Aug 2026 · Two awards of USD 5,000 each, distributed in the fall of 2026, to fund a research trip that furthers the artist's practice. No application fee.
  • LATITUDE Artist in Residence 2027 (Chicago)
    https://www.latitudechicago.org/artist-in-residence
    LATITUDE Chicago · deadline Closed 01 Sep 2026 · One-month production residency for 8-10 artists: a $1,000 printing stipend, unlimited scanning, a personal studio with a calibrated workstation, staff training and guidance on tech, an organised public event, and lifetime free lab access. No housing stipend. Free to apply before 16 August 2026; a $20 donation thereafter.
  • INHABIT #16 and #17: Artist-in-Residence 2027 (Max Planck Institute for Empirical Aesthetics)
    https://www.aesthetics.mpg.de/en/research/inhabit-artist-in-residence.html
    Max Planck Institute for Empirical Aesthetics · deadline Closed 01 Sep 2026 · Artist's fee of EUR 8,000 plus an accommodation fee of EUR 2,000, a production budget depending on the project, and travel costs to and within Frankfurt. Also included: realisation of the final project, collaborations with scientists, access to the institute's library, sound studio and scientific facilities, and curatorial support throughout the residency. No application fee.
  • Tartu UNESCO City of Literature Residency for Writers and Translators, Autumn 2026
    https://tartu.kirjandus.ee/residency-autumn-2026
    Estonian Literary Society (Eesti Kirjanduse Selts), Focal Point for Tartu UNESCO City of Literature · deadline Closed 01 Sep 2026 · Monthly stipend of EUR 600 for the two-month stay (EUR 1,200 in total), plus reimbursement of travel costs up to EUR 350. Free accommodation is provided in the Karl Ristikivi residency apartment, which has a bedroom, living room, kitchen, bathroom and exhibition room. One resident is selected. No application fee.
  • Le Garage Moderne: OASIS International Artist Residencies 2026 (Bordeaux)
    https://legaragemoderne.org/oasis2026
    Le Garage Moderne (European OASIS project) · deadline Closed 01 Sep 2026 · Five grants. Each artist receives a fee of EUR 1,300 gross (taxes may apply depending on legal status), up to EUR 600 for production expenses such as raw materials, technical services or special tools, a lump-sum travel grant scaled to distance with top-ups for green travel options, a per diem of EUR 45 per day, and accommodation in a self-catering hotel. Access to the shared tools and spaces of Le Garage Moderne is included, subject to the association's regulations. No application fee.
  • Numeric 2026: The Word (Les antipodes Research and Creation Residency)
    https://lesantipodes.com/numeric/2026_bases_en.html
    Les antipodes, with Bolit Centre d'Art Contemporani Girona and Museu de l'Emporda Figueres · deadline 08 Sep 2026 · Two grants. Each provides a stipend of EUR 1,000 as taxable base (taxes and withholdings apply), round-trip travel within the European Union, and accommodation and meals for the four weeks in Agullana. Travel and meals cover the resident only, though the shared apartment can host immediate family by arrangement. Numeric also provides the resources specified in the application and agreed during preparation. No application fee. Note that if a selected candidate lacks the professional registration needed to receive the stipend and payment has to be arranged through Les antipodes, the resulting costs are deducted from the stipend.
  • This is Gender Regional Curatorial Fellowship 2026
    https://thisisgender.global5050.org/regional-curatorial-fellowship/
    This is Gender (Global 50/50) · deadline 22 Sep 2026 · Stipend of up to GBP 3,000 for the seven-month part-time fellowship. No application fee.
  • 2027 d/p Curator Support Open Call (Seoul)
    https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1iSjEuCjay7DhL1AF1NCePu-5RV3t_10WT0CNcjNNJy8/preview
    d/p, sponsored by NakwonSangga · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · Curatorial grant of KRW 4,000,000 (including tax) per selected curator or team, plus use of d/p's approximately 187 square metre exhibition space for a five-week exhibition and curatorial collaboration with the d/p team. Approximately two curators or teams are selected. No application fee.
  • Teatri Riflessi 2027: Short Performance Competition (12th edition)
    https://www.iterculture.eu/en/teatri-riflessi/tr2027/tr12/
    IterCulture APS · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · Gross performance fee of EUR 500 to EUR 1,100 (VAT included) per selected short performance, scaled by the number of performers on stage, plus a possible travel contribution of up to EUR 250 subject to available funding, place of origin, cast size and absence of external touring grants. At least 10 performances are selected. Competition prizes: Best Performance EUR 1,200; Best Dramaturgy, Best Direction, Best Performer and the Scholars' and Critics' Award EUR 500 each; 'Valentina Nicosia' Fund EUR 500; 'Sandra Bressan' research fund EUR 1,800; Youth Jury Award EUR 300; plus non-cash awards (Audience Special Mention, Companies' Choice, Technical Crew). Panel members and Teatri Riflessi Network partners may also award special prizes in the form of artist residencies and touring opportunities. Application is free; selected companies pay a EUR 50 deposit that is fully refunded after the festival.
  • EMAP / EMARE: European Media Art Platform Residencies 2027
    https://emare.eu/
    European Media Art Platform (EMAP / EMARE) · deadline 06 Nov 2026 · EUR 4,000 grant for the applying artist (including subsistence); EUR 2,000 for a collaborating artist (EUR 6,000 total for a duo); EUR 4,000 project budget; accommodation provided by the host; travel covered per EU ceilings; access to technical facilities and media labs. No application fee.
  • Mondriaan Fund: Acquisitions (rolling)
    https://www.mondriaanfonds.nl/en/apply-for-a-grant/grants/acquisitions/
    Mondriaan Fund · deadline Rolling / undated · Maximum 40% of the estimated acquisition value, determined per application from the budget. The estimated value of the object must exceed EUR 50,000, and the applicant must contribute significantly to the acquisition costs. Applications requesting over EUR 500,000 are referred to the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science. No application fee.
  • Mondriaan Fund: Art Fair International (rolling)
    https://www.mondriaanfonds.nl/en/apply-for-a-grant/grants/art-fair-international/
    Mondriaan Fund · deadline Rolling / undated · GALLERIES: where 40 to 80% of presented works are by artists from the Netherlands and/or the Caribbean part of the Kingdom, 50% of the basic stand rental, capped between EUR 4,750 and EUR 9,000 depending on rental cost; where over 80%, 80% of the basic rental, with the same caps. PUBLISHERS: EUR 1,000 where 25 to 50% of publications concern relevant contemporary art, EUR 2,000 where over 50%. Maximum one application per fair per calendar year and no more than three awards annually. No application fee.
  • Mondriaan Fund: Artist's Fee (rolling)
    https://www.mondriaanfonds.nl/en/apply-for-a-grant/grants/artists-fee/
    Mondriaan Fund · deadline Rolling / undated · Determined per application: up to 50% of the standard amount excluding VAT, where the fee paid meets at least 100% of the guideline. Minimum application EUR 100. The fee must comply with the Fair Pay Rate Table 2023. No application fee.
  • Mondriaan Fund: Art Heritage Festival (rolling)
    https://www.mondriaanfonds.nl/en/apply-for-a-grant/grants/art-heritage-festival/
    Mondriaan Fund · deadline Rolling / undated · Up to 40% of eligible project costs directly tied to visual art and heritage activities. The project budget must exceed EUR 25,000. Grants of EUR 100,000 or more are highly exceptional and require contacting the fund first. No application fee.
  • Mondriaan Fund: Art Heritage Presentation (rolling)
    https://www.mondriaanfonds.nl/en/apply-for-a-grant/grants/art-heritage-presentation/
    Mondriaan Fund · deadline Rolling / undated · Up to 40% of variable project costs. The project budget must exceed EUR 25,000. Contributions of EUR 100,000 or more require contacting the fund directly. No application fee.
  • Mondriaan Fund: Collection Mobility (rolling)
    https://www.mondriaanfonds.nl/en/apply-for-a-grant/grants/collection-mobility/
    Mondriaan Fund · deadline Rolling / undated · Determined per application; the Mondriaan Fund finances up to 40% of eligible costs. Applicants must contribute significant funding themselves. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 18 new Visual & Media Arts grants - week of 17 Aug 2026
item.description:
• CPR Center for Performance Research: Artist-in-Residence Program 2027
    https://www.cprnyc.org/events/opencall-2027airprogram
    CPR - Center for Performance Research · deadline Closed 24 Aug 2026 · $2,000 stipend, 20 free hours of rehearsal space, up to 150 subsidised rehearsal hours across CPR's two studios with priority and advance booking, presentation slots in the OPEN LAB and OPEN AiR programmes, and access to technical equipment and production support. No application fee.
  • transmediale x DARC: Interstices, Research (in) the Gaps, PhD/Research Workshop
    https://transmediale.de/en/news/open-call-for-darc-phd-research-workshop-2027
    Digital Aesthetics Research Center (DARC), Aarhus University, in collaboration with transmediale · deadline Closed 28 Aug 2026 · No submission fee. The published call does not state a participation fee, honorarium, travel or accommodation support, so confirm with the organisers before budgeting. Accepted participants present a paper at the workshop and their condensed text is distributed as a newspaper-style article at the festival.
  • Youth Music: Trailblazer Fund (Round 13)
    https://www.youthmusic.org.uk/funding/i-need-funding/trailblazer-fund
    Youth Music · deadline Closed 28 Aug 2026 · GBP 2,000 to GBP 30,000 for organisations in England. No application fee.
  • Video Pool: Media Art + Technology Residency (MATR) 2027
    https://videopool.org/media-arts-technology-residency-2027-call-for-applications/
    Video Pool Media Arts Centre · deadline Closed 30 Aug 2026 · CAD 2,250 artist fee, covering both the residency period and the subsequent Poolside Gallery exhibition. Residents also get full access to VP's equipment, facilities and technical resources; the Poolside Gallery itself is equipped with two projectors and four speakers. Applicants must be VP members, so a membership is purchased separately, but there is no separate application fee.
  • Dot Line Space Art Foundation: Water Bodies & Ecology 2026 (Mumbai)
    https://www.dotlinespace.co.in/water-bodies-and-ecology-2026/
    Dot Line Space Art Foundation · deadline Closed 30 Aug 2026 · Grants towards travel and production expenses for selected artists. The call does not publish fixed amounts and does not state an artist fee or accommodation. No application fee.
  • Residing Non-linear Technologies and Sonic Worldings (M-Cult x Titanik, Helsinki and Turku)
    https://www.titanik.fi/residency-open-call-residing-non-linear-technologies-and-sonic-worldings/
    Art and Media Culture Agency M-Cult (Helsinki) and Arte artists' association / Titanik gallery (Turku) · deadline Closed 30 Aug 2026 · EUR 3,500 artist fee plus EUR 2,000 production budget, two months' accommodation split between Helsinki and Turku, and one return travel ticket from a Nordic-Baltic country. No application fee stated.
  • Inato Gallery: Touch Some Grass (open-call poster exhibition)
    https://www.inatogallery.com/open-call
    Inato Gallery · deadline Closed 31 Aug 2026 · No artist fee, stipend or production budget. This is an exhibition opportunity: selected posters are shown in Inato Gallery's Touch Some Grass exhibition. No submission fee is stated in the call.
  • DRIFT: Choreographer Open Call 2026-27 (Dance and Research In The Future Time)
    https://driftdance.eu/artists/open-call
    DRIFT, a four-year Creative Europe cooperation of ten organisations led by Theatre de Liege and Maison de la danse · deadline Closed 31 Aug 2026 · EUR 20,000 research budget per choreographer, covering artistic fees, travel, accommodation and optional collaborator costs. Also included: an Onboarding Lab, two weeks of residency with your national DRIFT partner, three collaborative Online Labs, a Festival Lab in Tunis, individual artistic mentoring and individual curatorial mentoring, and a work-in-progress presentation at the Biennale de la danse in Lyon. No application fee.
  • Surel's Place: Month-Long Artist Residency (September 2026 deadline)
    https://surelsplace.org/month-long-residencies/
    Surel's Place · deadline Closed 01 Sep 2026 · Free rent, utilities and wi-fi, a living stipend of USD 100 per week, a USD 300 travel stipend, use of well-maintained bicycles, free or discounted tickets to art events and movies, marketing through Surel's Place channels, and event hosting including logistics and installation help. Each resident also gets a local host to orient them and host their public events. No application fee. NOTE: Surel's Place takes a commission on sales arising from the residency, 35% of retail price on artwork, 45% on ticketed events that are offsite or need contracted services (calculated after administrative expenses), and 15% on books, CDs or other merchandise tangential to the artist's medium. A surcharge may apply to cover additional utility costs if a partner joins.
  • ITER 2026: International Touring and Environmental Responsibility Programme
    https://juliesbicycle.org/news/iter-2026/
    Julie's Bicycle and in futurum, funded by Arts Council England, Arts Council Norway, Creative Scotland and the Danish Arts Foundation · deadline Closed 01 Sep 2026 · The seminar programme is free to join. Groups of three or more participants can then apply for up to GBP 30,000 for collaborative projects, with funding applications open 6 November 2026 to 11 January 2027 and projects starting spring 2027. No application fee.
  • Arts Council England: Music Growth Fund, GBP 1,000-40,000 strand
    https://www.artscouncil.org.uk/music-growth-package/music-growth-fund-general-guidance
    Arts Council England · deadline Closed 03 Sep 2026 · GBP 1,000 to GBP 40,000, from a total annual budget of GBP 3,000,000 for this strand in 2026/27. You must find at least 25 percent of the total project budget as CASH match funding. No application fee.
  • Princeton Arts Fellowship 2027-2029 (Lewis Center for the Arts)
    https://apply.interfolio.com/187043
    Princeton University, Lewis Center for the Arts · deadline 08 Sep 2026 · USD 93,000 salary per year for each of two academic years, as a full-time 24-month appointment at the rank of Associate Professional Specialist. No application fee.
  • Mondriaan Fund: Voucher Art Event, Mexico Art Week 2027
    https://www.mondriaanfonds.nl/en/apply-for-a-grant/grants/voucher-art-event-mexico-art-week-2027/
    Mondriaan Fund · deadline 10 Sep 2026 · A voucher covering admission to the Zona Maco preview days, a curated programme during Mexico Art Week 2027, a networking event with the Dutch Embassy, and hotel accommodation from 2 to 7 February 2027, plus a EUR 1,300 contribution towards travel costs. 15 vouchers are available. No application fee.
  • Mondriaan Fund: International Collaborative Projects with Heritage Institutes (September 2026 round)
    https://www.mondriaanfonds.nl/en/apply-for-a-grant/grants/international-collaborative-projects-with-heritage-institutes/
    Mondriaan Fund · deadline 10 Sep 2026 · Determined per application. Up to 40% of variable project costs. For a development research phase, up to 70% of variable costs capped at EUR 15,000, covering travel, accommodation and presentation costs. The applicant must contribute significantly to the project financing, and the international partners' cost share must be proportional to the Mondriaan Fund grant. No application fee.
  • Mondriaan Fund: Heritage Innovation (September 2026 round)
    https://www.mondriaanfonds.nl/en/apply-for-a-grant/grants/heritage-innovation/
    Mondriaan Fund · deadline 17 Sep 2026 · Projects: up to 40% of variable project-related costs, with a minimum project budget of EUR 25,000. Research tracks: up to 70% of costs, capped at EUR 15,000, with no minimum budget. No application fee.
  • Ars Biologica ArtXScience Residency 2027-2028 (Ars Electronica x Ceske Budejovice ECoC 2028)
    https://ars.electronica.art/export/en/ecoc2028-ars-biologica-art-science-residency/
    Ars Electronica and Ceske Budejovice - European Capital of Culture 2028 · deadline 28 Sep 2026 · EUR 24,000 total package per winner: EUR 6,000 artist fee, up to EUR 15,000 production budget, and up to EUR 3,000 for travel, accommodation and subsistence, plus a separate budget covering one month of housing in Ceske Budejovice. Two positions available. Free to apply.
  • Trust me, I'm an AI/rtist: Open Call for Creative Interventions
    https://waag.org/en/article/open-call-creative-interventions-trust-me-im-airtist/
    Waag Futurelab (Horizon Europe project HAMLET) · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · EUR 20,000 commission fee excluding VAT, inclusive of artist fee, travel, accommodation and production costs. Applicants must have a VAT number in Europe. No application fee.
  • Amsterdams Fonds voor de Kunst: Project Subsidies 2026-2028 (rolling)
    https://www.amsterdamsfondsvoordekunst.nl/aanvragen/
    Amsterdams Fonds voor de Kunst (AFK) · deadline Rolling / undated · Project grants across four categories, from small awards up to substantial project budgets. Requests up to EUR 7,500 in categories 1 and 2 are scheduled by monthly draw (loting) rather than a queue. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 17 new Visual & Media Arts grants - week of 10 Aug 2026
item.description:
• AI Builders Fellowship 2026 (Internet Archive Canada x BC + AI)
    https://bc-ai.ca/fellowship
    Internet Archive Canada (IAC) in partnership with BC + AI · deadline Closed 21 Aug 2026 · $5,000 award for one selected builder. No application fee.
  • Mondriaan Fund: Inside-Out Art Museum Residency 2027 (Beijing)
    https://www.mondriaanfonds.nl/subsidie-aanvragen/regelingen/residency/inside-out-art-museum-beijing-china/
    Mondriaan Fund / Inside-Out Art Museum · deadline Closed 27 Aug 2026 · Subsidy of EUR 8,478 for an artist or EUR 5,622 for a curator/critic toward travel, material and living costs (a 10 percent personal contribution is automatically deducted by the Mondriaan Fund); studio, living space and Inside-Out Art Museum support are paid directly by the Mondriaan Fund. For a selected duo the total is increased proportionally to cover the second applicant's travel and accommodation. Contribution for Caribbean-based residents can be increased for higher travel costs. No application fee.
  • Helpmann Fellowships 2026
    https://helpmannacademy.com.au/helpmann-fellowships/
    Helpmann Academy · deadline Closed 31 Aug 2026 · Up to AUD 7,500 per fellowship, three fellowships available. Supported by the James & Diana Ramsay Foundation. No application fee.
  • University of East Anglia: Deputy Dean, CUCN-UEA Digital Creativity Institute
    https://vacancies.uea.ac.uk/vacancies/vacancy-search-results.aspx
    University of East Anglia (UEA), Faculty of Arts and Humanities · deadline Closed 31 Aug 2026 · GBP 69,488 to 73,709 per annum depending on qualifications and experience, plus the standard UEA pension and leave package. No application fee.
  • Gemeente Rotterdam: Project Subsidy Culture (Projectsubsidie Cultuur, September 2026 round)
    https://www.rotterdam.nl/projectsubsidie-cultuur-aanvragen
    Gemeente Rotterdam (Municipality of Rotterdam) · deadline Closed 01 Sep 2026 · No stated per-application cap. Annual pot EUR 1,632,000 split into six rounds of EUR 272,000, with roughly 130 applications per round. Discipline sub-caps: book writing max EUR 4,500; moving image R&D max EUR 4,000; moving-image production max EUR 12,500; post-production max EUR 4,000. Applicants must demonstrably seek other funds or sponsors. Awards over EUR 50,000 require an auditor's statement at reporting, at the applicant's cost. No application fee.
  • Kunstraad Groningen: Two-Year Programme Scheme (Tweejarige Programmaregeling, 2027-2028)
    https://kunstraadgroningen.nl/subsidies/tweejarige-programmaregeling/
    Kunstraad Groningen, on behalf of the municipality and province of Groningen · deadline Closed 01 Sep 2026 · EUR 5,000 minimum to EUR 40,000 maximum per year across two years, so up to EUR 80,000 total. Covers a maximum of one third of total project costs, requiring roughly 67 percent co-financing. Annual scheme budget EUR 325,000. No application fee.
  • Creative Australia: Arts Projects for Organisations (September 2026 round)
    https://creative.gov.au/investments-opportunities/arts-projects-organisations
    Creative Australia · deadline Closed 01 Sep 2026 · AUD 20,000 to 100,000. No matching or co-financing requirement. No application fee. Organisational administrative costs should generally not exceed 10 percent of the total project budget or the application becomes less competitive.
  • JUGAAD: Absolute Improvisation, open call for printed matter and small-format works (Amsterdam)
    https://sacartamsterdam.com/upcoming-programmes/
    SAC Art Amsterdam and Mama Magnet · deadline 05 Sep 2026 · No application fee. Selected work is sold at the printed matter fair on mutually agreeable terms regarding commission, duration and number of editions; artists are remunerated within 30 days of each sale. Unsold works are returned at the end of the agreed consignment period.
  • KNOWCASE Open Call 2027: permanent digital-culture installation in Madrid (Sonar+D x Fundacion Cotec)
    https://sonar.es/en/news/knowcase-open-call-2027
    Fundacion Cotec and Sonar+D · deadline 07 Sep 2026 · Up to EUR 100,000 (plus VAT), all-inclusive: conceptualisation, design, technical development, production, installation, maintenance, documentation, artist fees, travel, accommodation and insurance.
  • Fonds Podiumkunsten: Foreign Performances or Concerts in the Netherlands (round 4, 2026)
    https://fondspodiumkunsten.nl/subsidies/buitenlandse-voorstellingen-of-concerten-in-nederland
    Fonds Podiumkunsten (Performing Arts Fund NL) · deadline 23 Sep 2026 · Maximum EUR 25,000 per production, capped at EUR 75,000 for an applicant presenting multiple productions. Calculated on travel and transport costs of the foreign artists and their production only. EUR 267,500 available per round shared across this scheme and two sibling internationalisation schemes. Fees, venue and production costs stay with the applicant. No application fee.
  • Gemeente Utrecht: Project Subsidy Culture (Projectsubsidie Cultuur, round 3 2026)
    https://loket.digitaal.utrecht.nl/nl/producten/projectsubsidie-cultuur-aanvragen
    Gemeente Utrecht (Municipality of Utrecht) · deadline 25 Sep 2026 · Category A: EUR 1,000 to 5,000. Category B: EUR 5,000 to 20,000. No fixed co-financing percentage, but a budget and coverage plan is mandatory. eHerkenning purchase costs may be included in the budget and are reimbursed if awarded. No application fee.
  • BNG Cultuurfonds: Project Grants (round closing September 2026)
    https://www.bngbank.nl/bng-cultuurfonds/projectsubsidies
    Stichting BNG Cultuurfonds (BNG Bank) · deadline 27 Sep 2026 · EUR 5,000 minimum to EUR 15,000 maximum. The request must represent 5 to 35 percent of total project funding, so at least 65 percent co-financing is required. The fund is never the sole financier, and place-specific projects require at least one local or regional co-financier. No application fee.
  • Stichting Cultuur Eindhoven: Project Subsidy (Projecten, 2027 round 1)
    https://cultuureindhoven.nl/informatie-over-subsidies-2025-2028/
    Stichting Cultuur Eindhoven · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · Maximum EUR 35,000 per application and maximum 80 percent of eligible costs, so at least 20 percent co-financing is required. No application fee.
  • Gemeente Den Haag: Arts and Culture Projects Category B (autumn 2026 round)
    https://www.denhaag.nl/nl/subsidies/subsidies-cultuur-en-evenementen/subsidie-kunst-en-cultuurprojecten-aanvragen/
    Gemeente Den Haag (Municipality of The Hague) · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · EUR 10,000 to 30,000 per application. The municipal culture-budget contribution may not exceed 30 percent of the total project budget, so at least 70 percent co-financing is required. Annual ceiling for the strand is EUR 600,000. No application fee.
  • Stichting NORMA: NORMA Fonds Project Grant (round 4, 2026)
    https://www.stichtingnorma.nl/norma-fonds/aanvragen/
    Stichting NORMA (collecting society for performing artists) · deadline 30 Oct 2026 · Maximum EUR 10,000 per project. Total project budget may not exceed EUR 150,000 and the applicant organisation's annual budget may not exceed EUR 500,000. At least 25 percent of the project budget must come from audience or box-office revenue. Performer fees must meet the 2026 wage norms of EUR 139 per rehearsal and EUR 340 per performance. No application fee.
  • Brabant C: ASML x Brabant C Project Scheme (2026-2027, rolling)
    https://www.brabantc.nl/asml-x-brabant-c-project/
    Brabant C (Provincie Noord-Brabant culture investment fund) in partnership with ASML · deadline Rolling / undated · EUR 25,000 minimum, up to EUR 500,000. Contribution capped at 50 percent of total project budget, so 50 percent co-financing is mandatory. EUR 1.7 million available per year, split evenly between ASML and Brabant C. Requests at or above EUR 50,000 must include a future-viability plan. No application fee.
  • Het Cultuurfonds: Ontwikkelbijdrage for Individual Makers and Collectives (rolling, Netherlands)
    https://www.cultuurfonds.nl/aanvragen/individuele-aanvragen
    Het Cultuurfonds (formerly Prins Bernhard Cultuurfonds), via voordekunst · deadline Rolling / undated · Ontwikkelbijdrage (development contribution) up to EUR 5,000, awarded once every three years. A separate matchfundingbijdrage of EUR 250 to EUR 1,500 (max 50 percent of the crowdfunding target) is available once a year for public-facing projects. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 9 new Visual & Media Arts grants - week of 03 Aug 2026
item.description:
• G.MAP Digital Art Culture Lab 2026: Project Lab (Gwangju, South Korea)
    https://urbanartlab.org/opencall/
    Gwangju Media Art Platform (G.MAP) · deadline Closed 09 Aug 2026 · Track 2 (Interdisciplinary Creation): creation and production grant up to KRW 30,000,000 per team, plus accommodation, equipment, studio space, production and travel support, exhibition on G.MAP spaces and large-scale public media platforms (LED Wall, city media facades), and publication. Free to apply.
